newsitem.title: USA: CleveTrust ends merger talks, to liquidate.
newsitem.headline: CleveTrust ends merger talks, to liquidate.

text.p: CleveTrust Realty Investors on Friday said talks over the possible acquisition of all its shares by RM Crowe Co had ended without an agreement.

As a result, the Massachusetts-based real estate investment trust said it would proceed with its previously announced liquidation plan. It said that process should be completed sooner than the three years estimated earlier.
The company said liquidation distributions to shareholders should range from $6.00 to $6.50 per share, compared with an initial estimate of $5.00 to $6.65.
The company has scheduled a shareholders meeting April 29 to obtain approval for the plan.

The trust said it sold four of its properties since October 1, resulting in gains of about $7,170,000. It also said it had offers on several other properties, including a pending sales contract on the Executive Club Building in Denver at a price of $5.3 million.
It said it also had an offer on the Spring Village Shopping Center in Davenport, Iowa, for $4.45 million.
